findings.conflictNote: The document gives two different lead time figures. The general order terms section states 'Standard manufacturing lead time: 16 calendar days.' However, the production planning notes section states that serum formats (which are the relevant liquid/serum product category for this requirement) run a longer, separate cycle: 'Standard production cycle for serum formats is 26 calendar days from purchase-order confirmation, and buyers planning a serum launch should plan against that figure.' These two statements conflict regarding the applicable lead time, so no single numeric value is reported.
